name: mega-sdd
description: Spec-Driven Development as an autonomous agent pipeline: extract → intent → scan → bind → units → bolts. Anti-hallucination by construction — every claim cites its source, and spec↔code binding (CONFIRMED / CONFLICT / OQ verdicts) gates code generation. AST-precise codebase analysis (tree-sitter), ast-grep-validated Hard Rules, persistent memory, first-class subagents, and a consolidated /analyze consistency surface. Native binary deps (tree-sitter + ast-grep) with graceful regex fallback.
